description.en: Same as SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScriptAtMatch, but looks up the match roster member by team slot and field-position index instead of by param ID.
Slot index on that side (for multi-character techniques).
Team slot to look the member up in.
Field-position index of the member within that team.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Set up the defending character for a technique cutscene using a match roster slot
SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScriptAtMatchByIdx("DEF", 1, 0, 0);
